limitations: MuJoCo only; ideal own encoder/IMU/FSR readings and estimated contact odometry; physics pauses during RGB inference; no physical NAO validation. The selector inherits the v2 commitment time, even when it replaces a central guard with a jump or a lateral jump with a wide/central guard. The striker receives privileged scene observation with PerceptionNoise v1; the keeper context contains ball camera measurements and the v2 prediction only.
